misconfig_patterns: No authentication in default deployment — all endpoints open
GET /info discloses model_id, model_pipeline_tag, max_concurrent_requests, version
GET /metrics Prometheus scrape endpoint open — leaks throughput, request counts, latency histograms
Docker Registry FP: 'text-embeddings-inference' in banner matches ghcr.io image cache in Registry v2 catalogs — not a live TEI instance

active_probe.false_positive_check: response must contain model_pipeline_tag field with value feature-extraction — uniquely identifies TEI, not present in any LLM inference server

deployment_tells: Shodan-dark by default — GET / returns API JSON not HTML; root path not indexed by Shodan HTML crawler
Port 8080 is the canonical external mapping (docker -p 8080:80); port 80 is internal container port
Server: text-embeddings-inference/2.x in HTTP headers on some versions
GET /metrics returns Prometheus text exposition format with te_embed_* metric family
GET /info returns: model_id, model_sha, model_pipeline_tag, max_concurrent_requests, max_input_length, max_batch_total_tokens, version, docker_label
pivot_paths: GET /info → model_id → BAAI/bge-small/large/m3, nomic-embed-text, multilingual-e5, jina-embeddings-v3
GET /info → docker_label → image tag reveals TEI version (2.0.x, 2.1.x, 2.4.x)
GET /metrics → te_request_success{method='embed'} counter → usage volume inference
model_pipeline_tag: feature-extraction = pure embedding; feature-extraction + rerank = dual-mode
